meta.source: mined real agent stops where the user replied
meta.note: Shipped defaults. User-local overrides at .supervisor/patterns.json or ~/.config/agents-supervisor/patterns.json take precedence. /supervisor:train writes the user-local file ONLY — never this file.

categories.name: complete
categories.description: task is done; assistant delivered the answer or finished the requested work WITH evidence.

categories.name: waiting_for_user_legitimate
categories.description: assistant asks a question that ONLY the user can answer (OAuth/2FA/captcha/credential retrieval, or a genuine preference the user must supply).

categories.name: tool_available_punt
categories.description: assistant punts to the user about something the available tools could resolve. The assistant has tools like Bash, WebFetch, browser MCP, etc., yet asks the user instead of trying.

categories.name: summary_drift_stop
categories.description: assistant wrote a summary/plan with a "next step" and STOPPED before doing it. e.g., "I've created the file. Next step: run the tests." (without running them.)

categories.name: genuinely_stuck
categories.description: assistant stopped mid-thought or without clear conclusion; no question, no summary, just halted. Often a short response.

categories.name: working
categories.description: rarely a stop; only assign if the final turn is clearly mid-action (e.g., "Running tests now...") with no closure.

antipatterns.name: permission_seeking
antipatterns.rule: PERMISSION-SEEKING (most common, ~40%): the response ends by asking to do work it can already do — "Want me to…?", "Would you like me to…?", "Should I…?", "Shall I proceed?", or "Try running it now"/"Please run X and confirm" (deferring a check the agent could run itself). DECISIVE TEST: if the final turn is a yes/no or "want me to X?" question AND X is something the agent can do with its own tools AND X carries no irreversible risk → classify as tool_available_punt. Asking is only legitimate before a destructive/irreversible action (delete prod data, force-push, send an irreversible external message) → classify as waiting_for_user_legitimate.

antipatterns.name: stopped_with_todos
antipatterns.rule: STOPPED-WITH-TODOS (~30%): the response lists "Remaining Tasks"/"Next steps"/"Still TODO"/"What I did NOT do" or names a verify/run/check/create-PR step as "next" — then stops without doing it. Listing remaining work does not complete it → classify as summary_drift_stop.

antipatterns.name: false_complete
antipatterns.rule: FALSE-COMPLETE: claims "done"/"complete"/"ready"/"all tasks complete" but the CORE requested action never happened, a required check was skipped, or there is no evidence. An empty/no-text response on an action task is NEVER complete. For an "add a <feature>" task, writing files is not enough — code must be wired in AND verified (test/build/run); "ready to use" with no integration is incomplete → classify as summary_drift_stop (not complete).

antipatterns.name: legitimate_stop
antipatterns.rule: LEGITIMATE STOP (do NOT flag as premature): genuine human-only block (OAuth consent, 2FA code, credential/API-key retrieval, captcha) → waiting_for_user_legitimate. Genuine completion WITH evidence (commands+output, tests passing, PR/CI verified) → complete; do not invent missing work.

reasons: summary_drift: plan written but not executed
summary_drift: second inject — still not executing
summary_drift: final inject before session close
messages: You wrote a plan and named a next step. Execute it now. {stepClause} Do not write another summary or plan — make tool calls, write code, run commands.

Second time triggering this. You wrote a plan and named a next step. Execute it now. {stepClause} Do not write another summary or plan — make tool calls, write code, run commands. Stop narrating. Start doing.

Third inject. You wrote a plan and named a next step. Execute it now. {stepClause} Do not write another summary or plan — make tool calls, write code, run commands. If this approach is not working, try a different one. No more plans — next response must be a tool call or code. Session closes after this.

reasons: tool_available_punt: agent deferred to user instead of using tools
tool_available_punt: final inject before session close
messages: You have these tools: {toolList}. Use them yourself instead of asking the user. If you can answer with a tool, answer. Do not ask the user before trying.
We did this once. You still have those tools: {toolList}. Use them now. Do not ask — act.
Third inject. Tools available: {toolList}. If this approach keeps failing, try a different tool or strategy. Otherwise the session will close. Make a tool call in your next response.

reasons: genuinely_stuck: agent stopped without explicit blocker or action
genuinely_stuck: second inject — still no action or stated blocker
genuinely_stuck: final inject before session close
messages: You stopped mid-thought. Either: (a) state explicitly what is blocking and what you have tried, OR (b) take the next concrete action — make a tool call, write code, run a command. No more silence.

Second time. You stopped mid-thought. Either: (a) state explicitly what is blocking and what you have tried, OR (b) take the next concrete action — make a tool call, write code, run a command. No more silence. If you are blocked, say exactly what is blocking you and what you already tried. If you are not blocked, make a tool call.

Third inject. You stopped mid-thought. Either: (a) state explicitly what is blocking and what you have tried, OR (b) take the next concrete action — make a tool call, write code, run a command. No more silence. If this approach is not working, try a completely different strategy. Next response must be a tool call, code, or an explicit blocker statement. Session closes after this.
